text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly taking profits in Stocks B and E felt rewarding, but I should avoid trimming automatically just because a position is up; consider its outlook and portfolio role.","Selling Stock E at a substantial loss was painful, but I should assess whether its prospects and risk still justify holding it rather than letting loss aversion decide.","My buys in Stocks A and C and the account’s month-to-month swings remind me to manage overall allocation and risk, not judge each trade by short-term price moves alone."]}
